newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea securities houses post loss in 1st qtr FY9.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea securities houses post loss in 1st qtr FY9.

text.p: Hit by the sluggish stock market and a slew of corporate defaults, many South Korean securities houses posted losses in the first quarter of fiscal 1997 ending in March, the Koreas Stock Exchange said on Thursday.
An exchange statement said combined losses of 33 securities houses amounted to 70.71 billion won in the first quarter from an aggregate 97.67 billion profit a year earlier.
Since Hanbo Steel collapsed in January under crushing debt, the South Korean economy and stock market have been rocked by worries about corporate failures even by big conglomerates.
Hanhwa Securities posted the largest loss of 34.51 billion won during the period, followed by Daishin Securities with a 20.18 billion won loss.
Dongwon Securities topped the profit list with 16.92 billion won against 15.54 billion a year ago.
The statement said 15 securities companies posted losses in the first quarter including Daewoo Securities with 4.47 billion won and Samsung Securities with 2.57 billion won.
